_provenance.description: Pinned snapshot of the DISTINCT cell_type label vocabulary of every landed sc_normal_expression shard, one entry per shard slug. Read live from s3://onc-compbio via methods.sc_normal_expression.read (2-column projection, NO row filter) on 2026-09-18. Exists so the safety-essential entry vocabulary can be tested for INERT entries offline: an entry that matches nothing is a silent fail-open in a safety veto, and that is not detectable from the entry list alone.
_provenance.staleness_note: A shard release can ADD labels. This snapshot is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the real vocabulary: a test asserting an entry matches >=1 label here is sound, but a test asserting an entry matches NOTHING anywhere is only sound as of this snapshot and is why the intentionally-inert allowlist carries a re-probe obligation.
